issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as a public method, but the solution implementation declares it as protected. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended API and may cause tests or example usages that expect a public method to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method visibility consistent with the UML/problem statement. Change the solution implementation to declare the method public: in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java replace 'protected int getTotalNumberOfStudents()' with 'public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()'. Also ensure any template hints or TODO comments specify that the method should be public.
